summary: Backend 28/28 pytest pass (10 new tests for quota+apply+unlock + 18 carried over). Frontend E2E all 16 assertions green: SVG kangaroo mascot rendered in step1-card (1 <svg>) and no 🦘 emoji anywhere in landing/wizard DOM; verified flow on /freelancer/jobs shows VERIFIED green badge + quota-bar '3 of 3 FREE APPLIES LEFT' + UPGRADE ₹49 button; tapping job-apply-btn-{0,1,2} opens apply sheet with apply-note-input + apply-confirm-btn, after success the card flips to job-applied-tag-N and the quota bar decrements; 4th apply (job-apply-btn-3) opens paywall sheet with paywall-pay-btn; tapping it calls POST /api/freelancer/quota/unlock → quota-bar reads 'UNLIMITED APPLIES · 24H', apply sheet re-opens, and the 4th apply succeeds. Unverified user on /freelancer/jobs sees UNVERIFIED black badge, no quota-bar, an unverified-banner, UNLOCK CTA instead of APPLY, and tapping it routes to /freelancer wizard. Backend boundary tests cover 404/403/409/402 paths plus quota_used increments verified via /api/freelancer/{id}/quota.

action_items: Optional polish: silence 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' warning by moving pointerEvents into style in StepBlock (freelancer/index.tsx).
Optional: watch @gorhom/bottom-sheet for React 19 ref-as-prop migration; non-blocking console error on jobs screen.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py apply_to_job correctly orders checks: job 404 → freelancer 404 → 403 unverified → 409 dup → 402 quota. Quota 'used in last 24h' window is computed from applications.applied_at, so test isolation across days is safe.
/api/freelancer/quota/unlock writes unlimited_until on the freelancer doc AND a row in quota_unlocks; subsequent _get_quota_state correctly compares datetime.fromisoformat against now(timezone.utc).

freelancer/jobs.tsx submitApply branches on res.status===402 to swap from applySheet→paywallSheet via 280ms delay — works in practice (verified live). On unlock success it re-opens apply sheet with the original activeJob so the user finishes the apply they tried; verified in test.

KangarooMascot.tsx is a pure react-native-svg component (no external image) — renders fine on web preview. step1-card has exactly one <svg>; processing-overlay also wraps the mascot. No 🦘 emoji glyph anywhere in DOM body innerText.
MongoDB writes use freelancer_id as _id (string) and applications/_id = uuid; no ObjectId leaks. quota response model excludes _id properly.
